name: Water dish, terracotta with a step
label: Dishes
lead: Square terracotta-colored water dish, deeper, with a ribbed step in one corner that makes getting in and out of the water easier.
imageAlt: Water dish, terracotta with a step - NS Reptiles

description.html: This square water dish has higher walls than shallow dishes and a bright red terracotta color with a rough stone texture. One inside corner has a ribbed step, like a small stone ramp, leading from the bottom to the rim.

The combination of a deeper basin and a step makes it a good choice for animals that like to soak. Snakes and lizards can enter the water gradually via the step and climb out without effort. The same step also rescues insects that fall into the water. Check that your animal can fit fully into the dish.
The square shape fits easily into a corner or against the glass, and the red terracotta adds a warm accent to desert terrariums with red sand and rocks.

Do not fill the dish to the brim; leave enough room so the water does not overflow when your animal gets in. Place it on the terrarium floor or on firm, level substrate, because a deeper dish full of water must stand completely stable. Change the water every day and clean the step and corners with a small brush.
